title: Bockstein operations and AD algebras with unbounded torsion in $K_1$
summary: Eilers showed that for AD algebras of real rank zero with bounded torsion in $\mathrm{K}_1$, the coefficient transformations $κ$ are redundant in the classification by ordered scaled total $K$-theory. In this paper we treat the unbounded torsion case and prove that, in contrast, $κ$ becomes necessary.
